title.tr: Beton duvar önünde merdiven ve cam kapıya sahanlık
title.en: Stairs against a concrete wall with a landing at the glass door

alt.tr: Beton duvar önünde çaprazlı ahşap merdiven; cam kapının önünde küçük bir ahşap sahanlık
alt.en: Timber stairs with a cross-braced railing against a concrete wall, with a small timber landing in front of the glass door

caption.tr: Merdiven beton duvara paralel iniyor, alt ucunda cam kapıya açılan küçük bir sahanlık var. İş henüz bitmemiş.
caption.en: The stairs run down parallel to the concrete wall with a small landing at the bottom opening onto the glass door. The work is not finished yet.
